name: Travel Beat Vlog
summary: Cut a travel beat vlog to your own song: two fast montages on its drum hits, a hero photo with a big title behind the people, two 2x2 grids on the beat, per-slot reference colour and a fade.

compatibility.selects: Needs public Video/Audio overlays, clip effects and motion graphics, the editor's existing original Image placement service for the hero photo, a pinned Node.js that runtime.sh downloads on first use (no Node.js or Xcode Command Line Tools needed), and Apple Vision person instance masks (macOS 14 or later) through osascript (JavaScript for Automation) for the hero cutout. Verified in Selects Staging 2.0.519 and a local develop build on 2026-10-02 with a user song: saved Draft readback and export (pixel-identical between the two). The first-run Node.js download and the osascript cutout have not yet been run inside the app. Windows: not yet; the panel opens and says it is available on macOS for now.

inputs.label: Hero photo
inputs.hint: A photo with people; the title goes behind them.

inputs.label: Long shots
inputs.hint: Three shots of at least 3.6 s: under each grid and before the ending.

inputs.label: Clips
inputs.hint: For the two beat montages and the grids, in the order picked.

inputs.label: Song
inputs.hint: A song with a clear beat; the cuts follow its drum hits.

prepare: 26 travel videos, 1 photo with people in it and 1 song with a clear beat
An internet connection the first time (it downloads Node.js once)
